WITH quarters AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) AS current_q_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS current_q_end,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS prev_q_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) AS prev_q_end
),
current_q AS (
  SELECT
    'current_quarter' AS period,
    current_q_start AS period_start,
    current_q_end AS period_end,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.signup_date < q.current_q_start AND (c.churned_at IS NULL OR c.churned_at >= q.current_q_start)) AS customers_at_start,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.churned_at >= q.current_q_start AND c.churned_at < q.current_q_end) AS churned_in_period
  FROM dim_customers c CROSS JOIN quarters q
  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
  GROUP BY current_q_start, current_q_end
),
prev_q AS (
  SELECT
    'previous_quarter' AS period,
    prev_q_start AS period_start,
    prev_q_end AS period_end,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.signup_date < q.prev_q_start AND (c.churned_at IS NULL OR c.churned_at >= q.prev_q_start)) AS customers_at_start,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c.churned_at >= q.prev_q_start AND c.churned_at < q.prev_q_end) AS churned_in_period
  FROM dim_customers c CROSS JOIN quarters q
  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
  GROUP BY prev_q_start, prev_q_end
)
SELECT
  period,
  period_start,
  period_end,
  customers_at_start,
  churned_in_period,
  CASE WHEN customers_at_start = 0 THEN NULL ELSE churned_in_period * 1.0 / customers_at_start END AS churn_rate
FROM current_q
UNION ALL
SELECT period, period_start, period_end, customers_at_start, churned_in_period,
  CASE WHEN customers_at_start = 0 THEN NULL ELSE churned_in_period * 1.0 / customers_at_start END AS churn_rate
FROM prev_q
ORDER BY period_start;

  SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_revenue
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
cogs AS (
  SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_cogs
  FROM (
    SELECT period_month, MAX(amount) AS amount
    FROM fct_cogs
    WHERE source = 'cost_of_revenue'
    GROUP BY period_month
  )
)
SELECT
  revenue.total_revenue,
  cogs.total_cogs,
  (revenue.total_revenue - cogs.total_cogs) / NULLIF(revenue.total_revenue, 0) AS gross_margin
FROM revenue, cogs;

  SELECT DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('month', started_at) AS month_start
  FROM fct_subscriptions
  WHERE started_at IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT DATE_TRUNC('month', ended_at)
  FROM fct_subscriptions
  WHERE ended_at IS NOT NULL
),
month_ends AS (
  SELECT (month_start + INTERVAL 1 MONTH - INTERVAL 1 SECOND) AS eom_utc

)

  SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr
FROM month_ends me

JOIN dim_customers c
  ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id

ORDER BY month_end;

WITH starting_mrr AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr), 0) AS start_mrr
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND s.mrr > 0
    AND s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01')
),
losses AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr), 0) AS churn_and_downgrade_loss
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND s.mrr > 0
    AND s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
    AND s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
    AND s.ended_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
    AND s.status = 'cancelled'
),
downgrade_recovery AS (
  -- For cancellations that are actually downgrades (next sub starts within 1 day with lower MRR),
  -- only the DELTA counts as loss, not the full MRR. Add back the new (lower) MRR.
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(next_sub.mrr), 0) AS recovered_mrr
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
  JOIN fct_subscriptions next_sub
    ON next_sub.customer_id = s.customer_id
   AND next_sub.status = 'active'
   AND next_sub.mrr > 0
   AND next_sub.mrr < s.mrr
   AND next_sub.started_at >= s.ended_at
   AND next_sub.started_at <= s.ended_at + INTERVAL '1 day'
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND s.mrr > 0
    AND s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
    AND s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
    AND s.ended_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
    AND s.status = 'cancelled'
)
SELECT
  start_mrr,
  churn_and_downgrade_loss - recovered_mrr AS gross_revenue_lost,
  CASE WHEN start_mrr = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE (start_mrr - (churn_and_downgrade_loss - recovered_mrr)) / start_mrr
  END AS gross_retention
FROM starting_mrr, losses, downgrade_recovery;

WITH opp_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id,
    event_type,
    -- normalize timestamp to UTC
    CASE WHEN timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles'
         THEN timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles' AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
         ELSE timestamp
    END AS event_ts_utc,
    COALESCE(
      TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.deal_value') AS DOUBLE),
      TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.dealValue')  AS DOUBLE)
    ) AS deal_value,
    COALESCE(
      json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.opp_id'),
      json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.oppId')
    ) AS opp_id
  FROM fct_events
  WHERE event_type IN ('opp_created','opp_won','opp_lost','opp_no_decision','opp_stage_advanced')
),
-- Q2 FY2026 assumed calendar: 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30. "Going into Q2" = state as of 2026-03-31.
open_pipeline AS (
  SELECT opp_id, MAX(deal_value) AS deal_value
  FROM opp_events
  WHERE opp_id IS NOT NULL
    AND event_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
    AND opp_id IN (SELECT opp_id FROM opp_events WHERE event_type = 'opp_created' AND event_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01')
    AND opp_id NOT IN (SELECT opp_id FROM opp_events WHERE event_type IN ('opp_won','opp_lost','opp_no_decision') AND event_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01')
  GROUP BY opp_id
),
q2_won AS (
  SELECT SUM(deal_value) AS won_amount
  FROM opp_events
  WHERE event_type = 'opp_won'
    AND event_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
    AND event_ts_utc <  TIMESTAMP '2026-07-01'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(deal_value) FROM open_pipeline) AS open_pipeline_entering_q2,
  (SELECT won_amount FROM q2_won) AS q2_bookings,
  (SELECT SUM(deal_value) FROM open_pipeline) / NULLIF((SELECT won_amount FROM q2_won), 0) AS pipeline_coverage_ratio;

WITH quarters AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) AS curr_q_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS curr_q_end,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS prev_q_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) AS prev_q_end
),
base AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, c.churned_at, c.signup_date, c.is_test
  FROM dim_customers c
  WHERE c.is_test = false OR c.is_test IS NULL
),
quarter_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    'current' AS quarter_label,
    q.curr_q_start AS q_start,
    q.curr_q_end AS q_end,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.signup_date < q.curr_q_start AND (b.churned_at IS NULL OR b.churned_at >= q.curr_q_start)) AS active_at_start,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.churned_at >= q.curr_q_start AND b.churned_at < q.curr_q_end) AS churned_in_q
  FROM base b CROSS JOIN quarters q
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'previous' AS quarter_label,
    q.prev_q_start AS q_start,
    q.prev_q_end AS q_end,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.signup_date < q.prev_q_start AND (b.churned_at IS NULL OR b.churned_at >= q.prev_q_start)) AS active_at_start,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE b.churned_at >= q.prev_q_start AND b.churned_at < q.prev_q_end) AS churned_in_q
  FROM base b CROSS JOIN quarters q
)
SELECT
  quarter_label,
  q_start,
  q_end,
  active_at_start,
  churned_in_q,
  CASE WHEN active_at_start > 0 THEN churned_in_q * 1.0 / active_at_start ELSE NULL END AS churn_rate
FROM quarter_metrics
ORDER BY q_start;

  SELECT event_id, event_type, "timestamp", timezone,
    CASE WHEN timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles' THEN "timestamp" AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles' AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' ELSE "timestamp" END AS ts_utc
  FROM fct_events
  WHERE event_type IN ('opp_won', 'opp_lost', 'opp_no_decision')
)
SELECT

  COUNT(*) AS decided_opps,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'opp_won') * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS win_rate
FROM opp_outcomes
WHERE ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00';

  SELECT date_trunc('quarter', current_date) AS current_q,
         date_trunc('quarter', current_date) - INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS prev_q
)
SELECT
  date_trunc('quarter', ended_at) AS quarter,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN mrr ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(mrr), 0) AS churn_rate
FROM stg_subscriptions, quarters
WHERE date_trunc('quarter', ended_at) IN (quarters.current_q, quarters.prev_q)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH starting_cohort AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id
  FROM dim_customers c
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND s.started_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2026-01-01')
),
churned_in_period AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id
  FROM dim_customers c
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.churned_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND c.churned_at < DATE '2026-03-31'
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM starting_cohort sc
   WHERE sc.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM churned_in_period))::float
  / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM starting_cohort), 0) * 100
  AS churn_rate_pct

WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT i.paid_at, i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at < DATE '2026-03-31'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue'    THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-03-31'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals

WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT i.paid_at, i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at < DATE '2026-03-31'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue'    THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-03-31'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals

WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT i.paid_at, i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at < DATE '2026-04-01'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue'    THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-04-01'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals

WITH starting AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN s.started_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
            AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2026-01-01')
            AND s.mrr > 0
          THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS arr_start
  FROM dim_customers c
  LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
ending AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id,
    SUM(CASE
          WHEN s.started_at < DATE '2026-04-01'
            AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2026-04-01')
            AND s.mrr > 0
          THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS arr_end
  FROM dim_customers c
  LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT
  SUM(LEAST(e.arr_end, s.arr_start))::float
    / NULLIF(SUM(s.arr_start), 0) * 100 AS gross_retention_pct
FROM starting s
JOIN ending e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.arr_start > 0

WITH periods AS (
  SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS period_start, DATE '2026-03-31' AS period_end, 'current_quarter' AS label
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE '2025-10-01' AS period_start, DATE '2025-12-31' AS period_end, 'previous_quarter' AS label
),
starting_cohort AS (
  SELECT p.label, c.customer_id
  FROM periods p
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.is_test = false AND c.signup_date < p.period_start
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
   AND s.started_at < p.period_start
   AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > p.period_start)
),
churned_in_period AS (
  SELECT p.label, c.customer_id
  FROM periods p
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.is_test = false
   AND c.churned_at >= p.period_start
   AND c.churned_at < p.period_end
)
SELECT
  sc.label,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cip.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN sc.customer_id END)::float
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT sc.customer_id), 0) * 100 AS churn_rate_pct
FROM starting_cohort sc
LEFT JOIN churned_in_period cip
  ON cip.label = sc.label AND cip.customer_id = sc.customer_id
GROUP BY sc.label
ORDER BY sc.label

    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'opp_won'
                        THEN COALESCE(properties_jsonb->>'opp_id',
                                      properties_jsonb->>'oppId') END) AS won,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'opp_lost'
                        THEN COALESCE(properties_jsonb->>'opp_id',
                                      properties_jsonb->>'oppId') END) AS lost
  FROM fct_events
  WHERE (timestamp AT TIME ZONE timezone AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND (timestamp AT TIME ZONE timezone AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
    AND event_type IN ('opp_won', 'opp_lost')
)
SELECT won::float / NULLIF(won + lost, 0) * 100 AS win_rate_pct
FROM opp_outcomes

    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE churned_at IS NOT NULL) AS churned_customers,

  END AS churn_rate
FROM customer_churn;

WITH customer_status AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    signup_date,
    churned_at,
    is_test
  FROM dim_customers
  WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
), monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', signup_date) AS cohort_month,
    COUNT(*) AS customers_started,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE churned_at IS NOT NULL) AS customers_churned
  FROM customer_status
  WHERE signup_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  SUM(customers_churned) AS churned_customers,
  SUM(customers_started) AS total_customers,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(customers_started) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE CAST(SUM(customers_churned) AS DOUBLE) / SUM(customers_started)
  END AS churn_rate
FROM monthly_counts;

WITH arr_points AS (
    SELECT
        DATE '2026-01-01' AS as_of_date,
        COALESCE(SUM(mrr * 12), 0) AS arr
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00')
      AND lower(coalesce(status, '')) = 'active'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        CURRENT_DATE AS as_of_date,
        COALESCE(SUM(mrr * 12), 0) AS arr
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE started_at < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL 1 DAY
      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= CURRENT_DATE)
      AND lower(coalesce(status, '')) = 'active'
), ranked AS (
    SELECT
        as_of_date,
        arr,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY as_of_date) AS rn
    FROM arr_points
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN arr END) - MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN arr END) AS arr_growth_ytd_2026,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN arr END) AS arr_at_start_of_2026,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN arr END) AS arr_current,
    CASE
        WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN arr END) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN arr END) - MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN arr END)) / MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN arr END)
    END AS arr_growth_ytd_pct_2026
FROM ranked;

WITH customer_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        i.customer_id,
        SUM(i.amount) AS total_revenue
    FROM fct_invoices i
    WHERE i.status = 'paid'
      AND i.paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01'
      AND i.paid_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY i.customer_id
), customer_lifespan AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.signup_date,
        c.churned_at,
        CASE
            WHEN c.signup_date IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF('day', c.signup_date, COALESCE(CAST(c.churned_at AS DATE), DATE '2024-12-31'))
            WHEN c.joined_dt IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF('day', c.joined_dt, COALESCE(CAST(c.churned_at AS DATE), DATE '2024-12-31'))
            ELSE NULL
        END AS lifetime_days
    FROM dim_customers c
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
), customer_ltv AS (
    SELECT
        l.customer_id,
        r.total_revenue,
        l.lifetime_days
    FROM customer_lifespan l
    JOIN customer_revenue r
      ON l.customer_id = r.customer_id
    WHERE l.lifetime_days IS NOT NULL
      AND l.lifetime_days > 0
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_revenue), 2) AS customer_lifetime_value_fy2024
FROM customer_ltv;

WITH coverage_events AS (
    SELECT
        "timestamp",
        TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.covered') AS BOOLEAN) AS covered_bool,
        TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.is_covered') AS BOOLEAN) AS is_covered_bool,
        TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.coverage') AS DOUBLE) AS coverage_value,
        TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.pipeline_coverage') AS DOUBLE) AS pipeline_coverage_value,
        TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.value') AS DOUBLE) AS generic_value
    FROM fct_events
    WHERE event_type = 'pipeline_coverage'
      AND "timestamp" < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
), resolved AS (
    SELECT
        "timestamp",
        COALESCE(
            pipeline_coverage_value,
            coverage_value,
            generic_value,
            CASE
                WHEN covered_bool IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN covered_bool THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END
                WHEN is_covered_bool IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN is_covered_bool THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END
                ELSE NULL
            END
        ) AS coverage_metric
    FROM coverage_events
)
SELECT coverage_metric AS pipeline_coverage_going_into_q2_fy2026
FROM resolved
WHERE coverage_metric IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH now_anchor AS (
    SELECT CURRENT_DATE AS as_of_date
), quarter_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('quarter', as_of_date) AS current_q_start,
        date_trunc('quarter', as_of_date) + INTERVAL '3 months' AS next_q_start,
        date_trunc('quarter', as_of_date) - INTERVAL '3 months' AS prev_q_start
    FROM now_anchor
), customer_base AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        signup_date,
        churned_at,
        is_test
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
), quarters AS (
    SELECT 'current_quarter' AS quarter_label, current_q_start AS q_start, next_q_start AS q_end
    FROM quarter_bounds
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'previous_quarter' AS quarter_label, prev_q_start AS q_start, current_q_start AS q_end
    FROM quarter_bounds
)
SELECT
    q.quarter_label,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE cb.signup_date < q.q_start
    ) AS customers_at_start_of_quarter,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE cb.signup_date < q.q_start
          AND cb.churned_at >= q.q_start
          AND cb.churned_at < q.q_end
    ) AS churned_customers_in_quarter,
    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cb.signup_date < q.q_start) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE cb.signup_date < q.q_start
              AND cb.churned_at >= q.q_start
              AND cb.churned_at < q.q_end
        ) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE cb.signup_date < q.q_start
        )
    END AS churn_rate
FROM quarters q
CROSS JOIN customer_base cb
GROUP BY 1, q.q_start
ORDER BY q.q_start DESC;

WITH month_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 month' AS month_start,
    date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) AS next_month_start
), active_subscriptions AS (
  SELECT
    s.sub_id,
    s.customer_id,
    s.mrr,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY s.sub_id
      ORDER BY s.inserted DESC NULLS LAST, s.started_at DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  CROSS JOIN month_bounds mb
  LEFT JOIN dim_customers c
    ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND s.started_at < mb.next_month_start
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= mb.next_month_start)
    AND lower(COALESCE(s.status, '')) NOT IN ('canceled', 'cancelled', 'inactive', 'expired')
)
SELECT
  mb.month_start AS closed_month,
  COALESCE(SUM(a.mrr), 0) AS mrr
FROM month_bounds mb
LEFT JOIN active_subscriptions a
  ON a.rn = 1
GROUP BY 1;

    WHEN revenue.total_revenue = 0 OR revenue.total_revenue IS NULL THEN NULL

  END AS gross_margin
FROM revenue

  SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS total_revenue
  FROM fct_invoices i
  INNER JOIN dim_customers c
    ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE i.status = 'paid'
    AND COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
), cogs AS (
  SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE source = 'cost_of_revenue'
)
SELECT
  revenue.total_revenue,
  cogs.total_cogs,
  CASE
    WHEN revenue.total_revenue = 0 OR revenue.total_revenue IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE (revenue.total_revenue - cogs.total_cogs) / revenue.total_revenue
  END AS gross_margin
FROM revenue
CROSS JOIN cogs;

WITH arr_points AS (
    SELECT
        DATE '2026-01-01' AS as_of_date,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.mrr > 0 THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END), 0) * 12 AS arr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    INNER JOIN dim_customers c
        ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00')
      AND s.status = 'active'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        CURRENT_DATE AS as_of_date,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.mrr > 0 THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END), 0) * 12 AS arr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    INNER JOIN dim_customers c
        ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
      AND s.status = 'active'
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = DATE '2026-01-01' THEN arr END) AS arr_at_start_of_2026,
    MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = CURRENT_DATE THEN arr END) AS arr_current,
    MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = CURRENT_DATE THEN arr END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = DATE '2026-01-01' THEN arr END) AS arr_growth_ytd_2026,
    CASE
        WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = DATE '2026-01-01' THEN arr END) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (
            MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = CURRENT_DATE THEN arr END)
            - MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = DATE '2026-01-01' THEN arr END)
        ) / MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = DATE '2026-01-01' THEN arr END)
    END AS arr_growth_ytd_2026_pct
FROM arr_points;

      AND s.started_at < q.q_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.q_start)
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled')
),
true_churns AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN q_bounds q
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.status = 'cancelled'
      AND s.ended_at >= q.q_start
      AND s.ended_at < q.q_end
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM fct_subscriptions s2
          WHERE s2.customer_id = s.customer_id
            AND s2.status = 'active'
            AND s2.started_at >= s.ended_at
            AND s2.started_at <= s.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
      )
)
SELECT

      AND i.paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND i.paid_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'

)

WITH params AS (
    SELECT TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS q_start,
           TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AS q_end
),
base_subs AS (
    SELECT s.sub_id, s.customer_id, s.mrr, s.started_at, s.ended_at, s.status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at < p.q_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.q_start)
      AND s.mrr > 0
),
subs_with_outcome AS (
    SELECT
        b.sub_id,
        b.customer_id,
        b.mrr AS starting_mrr,
        CASE
            WHEN b.ended_at IS NULL OR b.ended_at >= (SELECT q_end FROM params) THEN b.mrr
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM fct_subscriptions s2
                WHERE s2.customer_id = b.customer_id
                  AND s2.status = 'active'
                  AND s2.started_at >= b.ended_at
                  AND s2.started_at <= b.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
                  AND s2.mrr > 0
                  AND s2.mrr < b.mrr
            ) THEN (
                SELECT MIN(s2.mrr)
                FROM fct_subscriptions s2
                WHERE s2.customer_id = b.customer_id
                  AND s2.status = 'active'
                  AND s2.started_at >= b.ended_at
                  AND s2.started_at <= b.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
                  AND s2.mrr > 0
                  AND s2.mrr < b.mrr
            )
            ELSE 0
        END AS retained_mrr
    FROM base_subs b
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(retained_mrr) / NULLIF(SUM(starting_mrr), 0), 4) AS gross_revenue_retention_q1_2026
FROM subs_with_outcome;

    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id

    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at < CAST(p.q_start AS TIMESTAMP)
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= CAST(p.q_start AS TIMESTAMP))

),

WITH quarter_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('quarter', current_date) - INTERVAL '3 months' AS quarter_start,
        date_trunc('quarter', current_date) AS quarter_end
),
subs_with_next AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status,
        s.mrr,
        LEAD(s.started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY s.customer_id ORDER BY s.started_at, s.sub_id) AS next_started_at,
        LEAD(s.status) OVER (PARTITION BY s.customer_id ORDER BY s.started_at, s.sub_id) AS next_status,
        LEAD(s.mrr) OVER (PARTITION BY s.customer_id ORDER BY s.started_at, s.sub_id) AS next_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
true_churn_events AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        s.ended_at
    FROM subs_with_next s
    CROSS JOIN quarter_bounds q
    WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
      AND s.ended_at >= q.quarter_start
      AND s.ended_at < q.quarter_end
      AND NOT (
          s.next_status = 'active'
          AND s.next_started_at IS NOT NULL
          AND s.ended_at IS NOT NULL
          AND s.next_started_at >= s.ended_at
          AND s.next_started_at <= s.ended_at + INTERVAL '1 day'
          AND COALESCE(s.next_mrr, s.mrr) < s.mrr
      )
),
churned_customers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS churned_customers
    FROM true_churn_events
),
customers_at_start AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) AS customers_at_start
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN quarter_bounds q
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at < q.quarter_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.quarter_start)
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled')
)
SELECT
    q.quarter_start::DATE AS most_recent_quarter_start,
    (q.quarter_end - INTERVAL '1 day')::DATE AS most_recent_quarter_end,
    cas.customers_at_start,
    cc.churned_customers,
    CASE
        WHEN cas.customers_at_start = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(cc.churned_customers::DOUBLE / cas.customers_at_start, 4)
    END AS churn_rate
FROM quarter_bounds q
CROSS JOIN customers_at_start cas
CROSS JOIN churned_customers cc;

WITH cancelled_subs AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.plan,
        s.mrr,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c
      ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.status = 'cancelled'
),
next_sub AS (
    SELECT
        c.sub_id AS cancelled_sub_id,
        n.sub_id AS next_sub_id,
        n.started_at AS next_started_at,
        n.mrr AS next_mrr,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.sub_id
            ORDER BY n.started_at, n.sub_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM cancelled_subs c
    LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions n
      ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id
     AND n.status = 'active'
     AND n.started_at >= c.ended_at
     AND n.started_at <= c.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
),
classified AS (
    SELECT
        c.sub_id,
        c.customer_id,
        c.plan,
        c.mrr,
        c.started_at,
        c.ended_at,
        CASE
            WHEN ns.next_sub_id IS NOT NULL AND ns.next_mrr < c.mrr THEN 'downgrade_cancellation'
            WHEN ns.next_sub_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'replaced_not_churn'
            ELSE 'true_churn'
        END AS cancellation_type
    FROM cancelled_subs c
    LEFT JOIN next_sub ns
      ON ns.cancelled_sub_id = c.sub_id
     AND ns.rn = 1
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS cancelled_subscriptions_v1_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cancellation_type = 'true_churn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS true_churn_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cancellation_type = 'downgrade_cancellation' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS downgrade_cancellation_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cancellation_type = 'replaced_not_churn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS other_replaced_cancellation_count,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cancellation_type <> 'true_churn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS pct_of_v1_churn_that_was_not_true_churn,
    'v1 was wrong because it treated every cancelled subscription as churn; some cancelled rows are immediate replacement subscriptions (especially downgrades within 1 day), so v1 overstated churn.' AS what_was_wrong
FROM classified;

WITH quarter_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('quarter', current_date) AS current_q_start,
        date_trunc('quarter', current_date) + INTERVAL '3 months' AS next_q_start,
        date_trunc('quarter', current_date) - INTERVAL '3 months' AS prev_q_start
),
subs AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status,
        s.mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c
      ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
true_churn_events AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        s.sub_id,
        s.ended_at AS churned_at
    FROM subs s
    WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
      AND s.ended_at IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM subs s2
          WHERE s2.customer_id = s.customer_id
            AND s2.status = 'active'
            AND s2.started_at >= s.ended_at - INTERVAL '1 day'
            AND s2.started_at <= s.ended_at + INTERVAL '1 day'
            AND COALESCE(s2.mrr, 0) < COALESCE(s.mrr, 0)
      )
),
quarter_starts AS (
    SELECT 'current_quarter' AS quarter_label, qb.current_q_start AS quarter_start, qb.next_q_start AS quarter_end
    FROM quarter_bounds qb
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'previous_quarter' AS quarter_label, qb.prev_q_start AS quarter_start, qb.current_q_start AS quarter_end
    FROM quarter_bounds qb
),
starting_customers AS (
    SELECT
        qs.quarter_label,
        qs.quarter_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) AS customers_at_start
    FROM quarter_starts qs
    JOIN subs s
      ON s.started_at < qs.quarter_start
     AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= qs.quarter_start)
     AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
churned_customers AS (
    SELECT
        qs.quarter_label,
        qs.quarter_start,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.customer_id) AS churned_customers
    FROM quarter_starts qs
    LEFT JOIN true_churn_events t
      ON t.churned_at >= qs.quarter_start
     AND t.churned_at < qs.quarter_end
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    qs.quarter_label,
    qs.quarter_start,
    COALESCE(sc.customers_at_start, 0) AS customers_at_start,
    COALESCE(cc.churned_customers, 0) AS churned_customers,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(sc.customers_at_start, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(cc.churned_customers, 0) * 1.0 / sc.customers_at_start, 4)
    END AS churn_rate
FROM quarter_starts qs
LEFT JOIN starting_customers sc
  ON qs.quarter_label = sc.quarter_label
 AND qs.quarter_start = sc.quarter_start
LEFT JOIN churned_customers cc
  ON qs.quarter_label = cc.quarter_label
 AND qs.quarter_start = cc.quarter_start
ORDER BY qs.quarter_start DESC;

WITH arr_ytd AS (
  SELECT
    EXTRACT(year FROM started_at) AS year,
    SUM(mrr) * 12 AS arr_ytd
  FROM fct_subscriptions
  WHERE status = 'active'
    AND started_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND started_at < CURRENT_DATE
    AND EXTRACT(year FROM started_at) = 2026
  GROUP BY 1
), arr_prior_ytd AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(mrr) * 12 AS arr_ytd_prior
  FROM fct_subscriptions
  WHERE status = 'active'
    AND started_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND started_at < DATE '2025-01-01' + (CURRENT_DATE - DATE '2026-01-01')
)
SELECT
  2026 AS year,
  a.arr_ytd AS arr_2026_ytd,
  p.arr_ytd_prior AS arr_2025_comparable_ytd,
  a.arr_ytd - p.arr_ytd_prior AS arr_growth_ytd,
  CASE
    WHEN p.arr_ytd_prior = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (a.arr_ytd - p.arr_ytd_prior) * 1.0 / p.arr_ytd_prior
  END AS arr_growth_ytd_pct
FROM arr_ytd a
CROSS JOIN arr_prior_ytd p;

  SELECT

      WHERE c.churned_at >= p.period_start

  FROM periods p

  GROUP BY 1
)

FROM arr_points;

  SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS period_start, DATE '2026-03-31' AS period_end
), starting_cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
  FROM dim_customers c
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date < p.period_start
    AND s.started_at < p.period_start
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > p.period_start)
), churned_in_period AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
  FROM dim_customers c
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.churned_at >= p.period_start
    AND c.churned_at < p.period_end
)
SELECT
  (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sc.customer_id)
    FROM starting_cohort sc
    WHERE sc.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM churned_in_period)
  )::DOUBLE
  / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM starting_cohort), 0) * 100 AS churn_rate_pct;

model_sql:
WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT i.paid_at, i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at < DATE '2026-03-31' + INTERVAL 1 DAY
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue' THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-03-31' + INTERVAL 1 DAY
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals;

WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT i.paid_at, i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at < DATE '2026-03-31' + INTERVAL 1 DAY
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue' THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-03-31' + INTERVAL 1 DAY
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25)) / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals;

WITH starting_customers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS cust_count
  FROM dim_customers c
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND s.status = 'active'
    AND s.started_at < DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2025-01-01')
),
churned AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS cust_count
  FROM dim_customers c
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.churned_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND c.churned_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
revenue AS (
  SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS rev
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE (
      CASE
        WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
          THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
        ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      END
    ) >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND (
      CASE
        WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
          THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
        ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      END
    ) < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
)
SELECT
  ((revenue.rev / NULLIF(starting_customers.cust_count, 0)) * 0.75)
    / NULLIF(churned.cust_count::DOUBLE / NULLIF(starting_customers.cust_count, 0), 0) AS ltv
FROM starting_customers, churned, revenue;

WITH params AS (
  SELECT TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-03-31 23:59:59+00' AS period_end
), open_opps AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(json_extract_string(e.properties_jsonb, '$.opp_id'), json_extract_string(e.properties_jsonb, '$.oppId')) AS opp_id,
    CAST(COALESCE(json_extract_string(e.properties_jsonb, '$.deal_value'), json_extract_string(e.properties_jsonb, '$.dealValue')) AS DOUBLE) AS deal_value
  FROM fct_events e
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE e.event_type = 'opp_created'
    AND timezone('UTC', timezone(COALESCE(e.timezone, 'UTC'), e.timestamp)) < p.period_end
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM fct_events e2
      WHERE COALESCE(json_extract_string(e2.properties_jsonb, '$.opp_id'), json_extract_string(e2.properties_jsonb, '$.oppId'))
            = COALESCE(json_extract_string(e.properties_jsonb, '$.opp_id'), json_extract_string(e.properties_jsonb, '$.oppId'))
        AND e2.event_type IN ('opp_won', 'opp_lost', 'opp_no_decision')
        AND timezone('UTC', timezone(COALESCE(e2.timezone, 'UTC'), e2.timestamp)) < p.period_end
    )
)
SELECT SUM(deal_value) / 5000000.0 AS coverage_ratio
FROM open_opps;

WITH normalized_invoices AS (
  SELECT
    i.amount,
    CASE
      WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
        THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
    END AS paid_at_la
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
), monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', paid_at_la) AS revenue_month,
    SUM(amount) AS revenue
  FROM normalized_invoices
  WHERE paid_at_la >= TIMESTAMP '2026-02-01 00:00:00'
    AND paid_at_la < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN revenue END), 0) AS march_2026_revenue,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN revenue END), 0) AS february_2026_revenue,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN revenue END), 0)
    - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN revenue END), 0) AS mom_change,
  (COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN revenue END), 0)
    - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN revenue END), 0))
    / NULLIF(COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN revenue END), 0), 0) AS mom_change_pct
FROM monthly_revenue;

WITH params AS (
  SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS period_start, DATE '2026-03-31' AS period_end
),
starting_cohort AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id
  FROM dim_customers c
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date < p.period_start
    AND s.started_at < p.period_start
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > p.period_start)
),
churned_in_period AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id
  FROM dim_customers c
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.churned_at >= p.period_start
    AND c.churned_at < p.period_end + INTERVAL 1 DAY
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sc.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM churned_in_period) THEN sc.customer_id END)::DOUBLE
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT sc.customer_id), 0) * 100 AS churn_rate_pct
FROM starting_cohort sc;

    WHERE sc.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM churned_in_period)
  )::DOUBLE

model_sql:
WITH periods AS (
  SELECT 'current_quarter' AS period_label,
         DATE '2026-01-01' AS period_start,
         DATE '2026-03-31' + INTERVAL 1 DAY AS period_end
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'previous_quarter' AS period_label,
         DATE '2025-10-01' AS period_start,
         DATE '2026-01-01' AS period_end
),
starting_cohort AS (
  SELECT
    p.period_label,
    c.customer_id
  FROM periods p
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.is_test = false
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.signup_date < p.period_start
    AND s.started_at < p.period_start
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > p.period_start)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
churned_in_period AS (
  SELECT
    p.period_label,
    c.customer_id
  FROM periods p
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.is_test = false
  WHERE c.churned_at >= p.period_start
    AND c.churned_at < p.period_end
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  p.period_label,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ch.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN sc.customer_id END)::DOUBLE
    / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT sc.customer_id), 0) * 100 AS churn_rate_pct
FROM periods p
LEFT JOIN starting_cohort sc ON p.period_label = sc.period_label
LEFT JOIN churned_in_period ch
  ON sc.period_label = ch.period_label
 AND sc.customer_id = ch.customer_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.period_label = 'previous_quarter' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

model_sql:
WITH quarterly_cohorts AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', s.started_at) AS cohort_quarter,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) AS cohort_size
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    WHERE s.started_at IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1
),
quarterly_churns AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', s.started_at) AS cohort_quarter,
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', s.ended_at) AS churn_quarter,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) AS churned_count
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    WHERE s.ended_at IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
churn_rates AS (
    SELECT
        c.churn_quarter,
        SUM(ch.churned_count) AS total_churned,
        SUM(co.cohort_size) AS total_active_base,
        ROUND(100.0 * SUM(ch.churned_count) / NULLIF(SUM(co.cohort_size), 0), 2) AS churn_rate_pct
    FROM quarterly_churns ch
    JOIN quarterly_cohorts co
        ON ch.cohort_quarter = co.cohort_quarter
        AND ch.cohort_quarter <= ch.churn_quarter
    JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT churn_quarter
        FROM quarterly_churns
    ) c ON ch.churn_quarter = c.churn_quarter
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    churn_quarter,
    churn_rate_pct
FROM churn_rates
WHERE churn_quarter >= DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 quarter')
ORDER BY churn_quarter DESC
LIMIT 2

    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS base_mrr
    FROM dim_customers c
    INNER JOIN fct_subscriptions s 
        ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id

      AND s.started_at < '2026-01-01'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= '2026-01-01')
      AND c.is_test = false
      AND s.mrr > 0
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
cohort_end AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS end_mrr
    FROM dim_customers c
    INNER JOIN fct_subscriptions s 
        ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status = 'active'
      AND s.started_at < '2026-04-01'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= '2026-04-01')
      AND c.is_test = false
      AND s.mrr > 0
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(e.end_mrr), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(b.base_mrr), 0) * 100, 2) AS net_retention_rate_pct
FROM cohort_base b
LEFT JOIN cohort_end e ON b.customer_id = e.customer_id

WITH cancelled_mrr AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(mrr), 0) AS cancelled_mrr_sum
  FROM stg_subscriptions
  WHERE status = 'cancelled'
    AND ended_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND ended_at < DATE '2026-04-01'
),
all_mrr AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(mrr), 0) AS all_subscription_mrr_sum
  FROM stg_subscriptions
  WHERE ended_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND ended_at < DATE '2026-04-01'
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN all_mrr.all_subscription_mrr_sum = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE cancelled_mrr.cancelled_mrr_sum / all_mrr.all_subscription_mrr_sum
  END AS churn_rate
FROM cancelled_mrr
CROSS JOIN all_mrr

  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', MAX(ended_at)) AS quarter_start
  FROM stg_subscriptions
  WHERE ended_at IS NOT NULL
),

  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr), 0) AS cancelled_mrr_sum
  FROM stg_subscriptions s
  CROSS JOIN most_recent_quarter mq
  WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
    AND s.ended_at >= mq.quarter_start

),
total_mrr AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr), 0) AS all_subscription_mrr_sum
  FROM stg_subscriptions s
  CROSS JOIN most_recent_quarter mq
  WHERE s.ended_at >= mq.quarter_start
    AND s.ended_at < mq.quarter_start + INTERVAL '3 months'
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN t.all_subscription_mrr_sum = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE c.cancelled_mrr_sum / t.all_subscription_mrr_sum
  END AS churn_rate
FROM cancelled_mrr c
CROSS JOIN total_mrr t

WITH current_quarter AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) AS quarter_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '3 months' - INTERVAL '1 day' AS quarter_end
),
previous_quarter AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '3 months' AS quarter_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 day' AS quarter_end
),
current_qtr_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    'Current Quarter' AS period,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'cancelled' THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cancelled_mrr,
    COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr), 0) AS total_mrr
  FROM stg_subscriptions s
  CROSS JOIN current_quarter cq
  WHERE s.ended_at >= cq.quarter_start
    AND s.ended_at <= cq.quarter_end
),
previous_qtr_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    'Previous Quarter' AS period,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'cancelled' THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cancelled_mrr,
    COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr), 0) AS total_mrr
  FROM stg_subscriptions s
  CROSS JOIN previous_quarter pq
  WHERE s.ended_at >= pq.quarter_start
    AND s.ended_at <= pq.quarter_end
)
SELECT
  period,
  CASE
    WHEN total_mrr = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE cancelled_mrr / total_mrr
  END AS churn_rate
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM current_qtr_metrics
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM previous_qtr_metrics
)
ORDER BY period DESC

    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-04-01'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT

)
SELECT

   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals

WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT i.paid_at, i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at < DATE '2026-03-31'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue'    THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-03-31'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals

WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT i.paid_at, i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at < DATE '2026-04-01'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue'    THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-04-01'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals

WITH starting_customers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS cust_count
  FROM dim_customers c
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND s.status = 'active'
    AND s.started_at < DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2025-01-01')
),
churned AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS cust_count
  FROM dim_customers c
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.churned_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND c.churned_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
revenue AS (
  SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS rev
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE
    (CASE
      WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
        THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
    END) >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND (CASE
      WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
        THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
    END) < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
)
SELECT
  ((revenue.rev / NULLIF(starting_customers.cust_count, 0)) * 0.75)
    / NULLIF(churned.cust_count::float
              / NULLIF(starting_customers.cust_count, 0), 0)
    AS ltv
FROM starting_customers, churned, revenue

  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'opp_won'
                        THEN COALESCE(properties_jsonb->>'opp_id',
                                      properties_jsonb->>'oppId') END) AS won,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'opp_lost'
                        THEN COALESCE(properties_jsonb->>'opp_id',
                                      properties_jsonb->>'oppId') END) AS lost
  FROM fct_events
  WHERE (timestamp AT TIME ZONE timezone AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND (timestamp AT TIME ZONE timezone AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
    AND event_type IN ('opp_won', 'opp_lost')
)
SELECT
  won::float / NULLIF(won + lost, 0) * 100 AS win_rate_pct
FROM opp_outcomes
